title: Tesla’s Cybercab has been deployed, and it’s already under investigation
summary: The US government is investigating whether the Cybercab meets vehicle safety standards.
llm_summary: Tesla has begun rolling out its autonomous “Cybercab” service, but federal regulators have already opened an inquiry to determine whether the driver‑less vehicles comply with existing safety standards. The investigation will examine everything from the cars’ sensor suite and software controls to crash‑worthiness, potentially affecting the rollout timeline. If the Cybercab fails to meet the required criteria, Tesla could face fines, mandatory design changes, or a halt to the service.
